summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread got stuck in a wait state (heartbeat still updating) and stopped consuming the queue; the deeper cause of the stall is unknown.
recommended: Investigate why the worker enters a wait state and stops consuming (add a stall watchdog / alert on processed not advancing)
Alert on queue depth growth, since the heartbeat stayed fresh while the worker was stuck

args.impact: Queue backlog peaked at 41 orders (queued_orders total_sar 29390.18 at that point), delayed but not lost. After the restart all 82 orders were processed and paid. 0 dropped, 0 unpaid, 0 ledger failures.

args.summary: The queue backlog came from a stuck worker that kept a fresh heartbeat but processed nothing. I restarted it and it drained the queue. All 82 orders now have payments and the invariants are green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown, so the stall could happen again.
